name: MotionSites Web Builder (free Claude skill)
summary: Free Claude skill/plugin for building cinematic landing pages: 40 example prompts, a media shelf (50+ hero videos, 30 3D cut-outs, 29 images), 55+ technique recipes with code (video loops, liquid glass, scroll stories, Three.js), design rules, a spec template and a screenshot-and-fix QA loop. Can also output prompts for Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor and others.

access.notes: Instructions/scripts MIT. Example prompts and media are (c) MotionSites: usable to build sites incl. for clients, but no resale or redistribution as a prompt/media collection. Free sample of a paid library.

procedure: Claude.ai/desktop: Customize > Skills > + > Upload a skill, pick the zip, enable it (code execution must be on).
Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Motionsites-AI/claude-skill then /plugin install motionsites-web-builder@motionsites.
Optional: pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium for the screenshot QA loop.

verdict.why: Genuinely free and installable with MIT code, but it is a marketing funnel to a paid library and the bundled media are not freely redistributable.
